#!name=苏e行
#!desc=fmz200/wool_scripts · 某些APP要清除缓存或者重新安装拦截广告才会生效！
#!author=奶思

[MITM]
hostname = ad.shunchangzhixing.com, api.bwton.com

[Rewrite]
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/ad\.shunchangzhixing\.com\/getAd/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/api\.bwton\.com\/bff\/app\/h5\/v1\/station\/goods/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/api\.bwton\.com\/bas\/ad/i then reject(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/api\.bwton\.com\/bff\/app\/index\/goods/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/api\.bwton\.com\/bff\/app\/index\/recommend/i then reject_dict(200)
